subject: Request: Temporary increase to rate tier for onboarding burst - MedTech Labs
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medtechlabs.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>; vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medtechlabs.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Temporary increase to rate tier for onboarding burst - MedTech Labs

Hi Hannah and Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. We're planning a three-week ramp where our ingestion pipeline will spike as we onboard 12 internal models and 30k daily inference requests for conversational assistants.

Our current forecast shows we'll hit the standard rate cap within 48 hours of the pilot start. Procurement asked us to request a short-term rate-tier increase (higher burst allowance and a relaxed fairness throttle) while we complete validation. Specifically: a 3x burst quota for the first 21 days and a temporary adjustment to the fairness policy that prevents cross-customer throttling during the onboarding window.

Can Redwood approve an exception for Nov 9 - Nov 30? We'll provide daily usage snapshots and are willing to take a short-term premium for guaranteed throughput. I attached an initial usage snapshot and we've begun filling out the procurement paperwork.

Attachments: medtech-usage-snapshot-2026-10.csv

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Platform Integrations
MedTech Labs
elaine.park@medtechlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medtechlabs.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@medtechlabs.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary increase to rate tier for onboarding burst - MedTech Labs

Thanks, Elaine — this is helpful. I've looped in Karthik from Capacity & Pricing and Vivek from Sales Ops so we can triage the request quickly.

Two quick asks from our side to evaluate an exception:
- Can you confirm the traffic distribution across the 30k daily requests (peak QPS window and sequence length profile)?
- Are the 12 models identical replicas or a mix of sizes (e.g., 7 small, 5 large)?

I'll start the internal exception ticket and attach your usage snapshot. If we can get a short traffic sample (one-day hour-by-hour CSV) it speeds approval. We generally support short-term burst increases for onboarding; approval depends on conflict with other reserved capacity and estimated token volume.

Next steps: Karthik will validate capacity impact and propose a temporary policy (burst multiplier, throttle threshold, fallback model). Vivek — can you flag any existing Dedicated pools that might absorb part of the load if needed?

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>; vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>; Elaine Park <elaine.park@medtechlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 14:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary increase to rate tier for onboarding burst - MedTech Labs

Hannah / Elaine — I reviewed the snapshot and ran a conservative capacity estimate. Summary:
- Estimated peak token/sec: ~12k (short bursts during weekday mornings).
- If we grant a 3x burst multiplier for 21 days, risk to shared hosted pools is moderate but manageable with mitigations.

Proposed exception terms (draft):
1) Temporary burst multiplier: 3x from 2026-11-09T00:00 to 2026-11-30T23:59 PT.
2) Fairness policy: MedTech will be insulated from fairness-based preemption up to the burst cap; beyond that, standard throttling applies.
3) Monitoring & rollback: Daily usage reporting required (you provided a CSV; please push hourly for the first 72 hours). Redwood reserves the right to roll back the exception if cross-customer latency impact > 10% on critical endpoints.
4) Optional paid priority: If MedTech elects paid priority, we can increase sustained throughput and offer SLA credit in case of violations.

I'm attaching the SLA exception form to formalize the terms. Elaine, if these look reasonable, return the signed PDF and we'll provision the temporary rule and a monitoring dashboard.

Attachments: sla-exception-form.pdf

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Capacity & Pricing | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@medtechlabs.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medtechlabs.com>, procurement@medtechlabs.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary increase to rate tier for onboarding burst - MedTech Labs

Hannah / Karthik — thanks for the quick review and proposed terms. MedTech is fine with the draft exception and the rollback clause; we will push hourly usage as requested. Two notes from procurement:
1) We'll sign the SLA exception PDF and return by EOD Nov 4.
2) We need a DocuSign or signed HubSpot link for our legal team to track execution. Can Redwood provide a DocuSign link?

Also — if paid priority is available, we'd like ballpark pricing to evaluate. Can you send a short note on the premium on top of the standard per-token rate?

I'll attach the signed form once legal completes review.

Best,
Tom Reyes
Director of Procurement
MedTech Labs
